caption: The drawing depicts a single round porcelain plate with a gently scalloped rim. The edge of the plate is outlined with a narrow gold band. The plate itself is mostly white or light gray with faint shading to indicate its rounded form. Three groups of small, delicate floral decorations are arranged on the upper left, upper right, and lower right portions of the plate, featuring light pink flowers with green and brown stems and leaves. Below the main plate, there is a small pencil sketch showing the plate from a different perspective and providing a simple outline of the floral arrangement. On the left side beneath the plate, there is a circular decorative seal or emblem, possibly a maker's mark, rendered in brown ink. The whole composition is contained within a lightly outlined square.
title: Dinner Platter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
